sentences.text: As per contents of first information report, allegation has been levelled of fabrication of sale deed registered on 22nd May, 2013 of property belonging to the father of informant.
The applicant is indicated as marginal witness.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for applicant that he has been falsely implicated in the charges levelled against him which is evident from the fact that applicant has been indicated only as a marginal witness and not either as a vendee, vendor or beneficiary of the said transaction.
It is submitted that unnecessary criminal colour is being sought to be given to a purely civil dispute.
It is submitted that chargesheet has not yet been filed and the applicant does not have any previous criminal history.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed bail application with the submission that investigation in the matter is still ongoing.
It is however admitted that applicant does not have any previous criminal history.

Upon consideration of submissions advanced by learned counsel for parties and perusal of material on record, prima facie, it appears that the only role assigned to the applicant is that o f being a marginal witness in the registered sale deed dated 22nd May, 2013.
It also appears that a suit for declaration regarding its cancellation is also pending.
Prima facie it appears that the dispute pertains only to civil dispute.
The applicant does not have any previous criminal history.

Without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the that the liberty of the applicant may be protected in view of dictum of Apex Court in re: Sushila Aggarwal Vs.
State (NCT of Delhi)-2020 SCC online SC 98.
In view of the above
